# cairn serve

Run the desktop GUI backend (HTTP server on localhost).

## Help

```text
Starts the cairn-desktop axum server on a localhost port. Used as a sidecar by Cairn.app; can also
be run standalone for debugging. Port 0 binds an ephemeral port and prints the bound address to
stdout as the first line.

Usage: cairn serve [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --port <PORT>
          TCP port (0 = ephemeral)

          [default: 4000]

      --host <HOST>
          Bind address

          [default: 127.0.0.1]

      --vault <PATH>
          Vault directory (currently informational — alpha serves the fixture dataset; real-vault
          binding is a follow-up issue)

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```
